parties: Indo Thai Securities Limited (ITSL) and Indo Thai Financial Services Limited (ITFSL)
headline: Indo Thai Securities Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: ITSL notified unsecured creditors' meeting scheduled for 24 July 2026 under NCLT-approved Scheme of Arrangement involving restructuring/reorganization between Indo Thai Securities and Indo Thai Financial Services.
implication: Scheme of Arrangement under §230-232 of Companies Act, 2013 requires NCLT approval and creditor vote; this is a group-level restructuring triggering regulatory approvals by NSE and NCLT oversight.
detail: ITSL filed formal notice with NSE on 19 June 2026 for unsecured creditors' meeting on 24 July 2026. The meeting is directed by NCLT, Indore Bench, and involves shareholders of both ITSL and ITFSL in a restructuring/reorganization transaction. The scheme appears to consolidate or reorganize the two related entities within the Indo Thai group.
